calculation.description: Ranks assets for contrarian exposure to their trailing three-day return, scaled by trailing 20-day daily return volatility. Higher values indicate stronger recent weakness adjusted for typical risk. Computed using data available through the decision date only.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (0.045392; 760 observations), 2023-2024 (0.023214; 516), and 2025-2026 (0.040098; 504). The 1-day IC and ICIR exceed benchmark admission thresholds of 0.0070 and 0.0840. Five-day and ten-day results are reported for decay, not used for admission.
